name: Chicken, Apple & Squash Skillet over Couscous with Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 Granny Smith apples
1 ½ small butternut squash
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Sprinkle with flour, salt, and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, using a clean cutting board, halve, peel, and thinly slice onions. Place in a large bowl.
Quarter, core, and slice apples into wedges; add to the bowl with the onion.
Trim and peel each squash. Halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and medium dice; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the veggies and apple (reserve remaining parsley for garnish).

Return pot to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, apple, parsley, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, place vinegar, oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies and apple are soft, add broth, vinegar, honey, and Dijon to the pot; stir to combine and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until apple and squash are tender, 5-6 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup apple cider vinegar
3 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
Return chicken to the pot with the veggies and apple; continue to cook, turning the chicken occasionally, until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
To serve, divide couscous, chicken sauté, and salad between plates. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!
